target.title: Fable II Game of the Year Edition

provenance: exact TU1 generated ReXGlue body: 209 PPC instructions
TU1 string reference at 0x82AAC254 to ProcessAsyncCommandQueues timing label
candidates.observed_arguments_and_layout: Generated body is consistent with an object method and queue processing, but G1 did not establish a stable public command structure or per-command layout.
candidates.distinguishing_evidence: The title-owned diagnostic label identifies queue processing; no evidence yet proves this function is the enqueue boundary or that commands preserve D3D semantics.
candidates.expected_side_effects_and_risks: May consume multiple queues, mutate queue ownership, signal synchronization, or recurse into Xbox graphics methods. Hook only after thread/order behaviour is traced.

provenance: exact TU1 generated ReXGlue body: 88 PPC instructions
candidates.observed_arguments_and_layout: Prepares device initialization inputs and calls the lower allocation/initialization bridge; complete input structure semantics are not confirmed.
candidates.distinguishing_evidence: It is above Vd/ring setup and coordinates title state, but could be a Fable wrapper rather than the Xbox CreateDevice implementation.
candidates.expected_side_effects_and_risks: Global device publication, ownership, initial presentation, and failure cleanup must remain byte-for-byte guest behaviour.

candidates.role: graphics device allocation and initialization bridge
provenance: exact TU1 generated ReXGlue body: 195 PPC instructions
passes the object and a 0x7C-byte initialization/presentation block to sub_82BA6990
candidates.observed_arguments_and_layout: The allocated device-like object is 0x5E80 bytes. A 0x7C-byte block is forwarded into the confirmed GPU/device initializer.
candidates.distinguishing_evidence: Allocation size, downstream Vd initialization, and title creation flow distinguish it from a small thunk; the exact XDK API name is unconfirmed.
candidates.expected_side_effects_and_risks: Allocation identity, constructor ordering, virtual/function tables, reference counts, and failure cleanup must be preserved.

provenance: exact TU1 generated ReXGlue body: 102 PPC instructions
candidates.observed_arguments_and_layout: Loads the global device, manages related object references, and passes a device plus front-buffer/surface-like object into sub_82BA34D8.
candidates.distinguishing_evidence: It retains title object/reference semantics above the confirmed VdSwap emitter, but G1 does not prove it is the sole engine frame boundary.
candidates.expected_side_effects_and_risks: Reference lifetime, frame pacing, error propagation, and any re-entrant presentation callbacks must remain unchanged.

provenance: exact TU1 generated ReXGlue body: 284 PPC instructions
candidates.observed_arguments_and_layout: Operates on the device object and allocates/configures guest physical command buffers, read-pointer writeback, and GPU identifier storage.
candidates.distinguishing_evidence: Named Vd imports prove transport setup rather than a semantic draw/resource API.
candidates.expected_side_effects_and_risks: Guest physical allocations, MMIO-visible addresses, ring ownership, and writeback setup are renderer-critical and must not be bypassed.

provenance: exact TU1 generated ReXGlue body: 457 PPC instructions
candidates.observed_arguments_and_layout: Callers pass r3 as a device-like object, r4 as a front-buffer/surface-like object, and r5 as flags. The function obtains a system command buffer and reaches VdSwap.
candidates.distinguishing_evidence: The VdSwap call proves presentation transport. Its large body and command-buffer management distinguish it from a thunk; it is below the title coordinator but above PM4 consumption.
candidates.expected_side_effects_and_risks: Must preserve command-buffer writes, front-buffer metadata, pacing, callbacks, synchronization, return value, and all guest-visible errors.

candidates.role: compact Xbox graphics engine shutdown helper
provenance: exact TU1 generated ReXGlue body: 10 PPC instructions
candidates.observed_arguments_and_layout: Forwards a device/engine shutdown operation; no additional stable object layout was established.
candidates.distinguishing_evidence: The VdShutdownEngines import confirms lifecycle semantics; absence of a generated direct caller leaves invocation ownership unresolved.
candidates.expected_side_effects_and_risks: May be indirect/function-table invoked. Duplicate shutdown or missing engine teardown would be fatal.

provenance: exact TU1 generated ReXGlue body: 162 PPC instructions
candidates.observed_arguments_and_layout: Receives the 0x5E80-byte device-like allocation and 0x7C-byte initialization block. Initializes critical sections at device offsets 0x3A60 and 0x3A7C before engine/ring setup.
candidates.distinguishing_evidence: Vd engine/interrupt imports and downstream ring setup prove GPU lifecycle initialization; the public XDK function name remains unknown.
candidates.expected_side_effects_and_risks: Critical-section state, interrupt callback, guest ring allocation, and partial-initialization cleanup must stay exact.

provenance: exact TU1 generated ReXGlue body: 168 PPC instructions
candidates.observed_arguments_and_layout: Operates on the device object, disables the graphics callback, tears down engine/ring state, and participates in object cleanup.
candidates.distinguishing_evidence: Named shutdown and callback imports prove the lifecycle role; it is a full cleanup routine rather than a thunk.
candidates.expected_side_effects_and_risks: Ordering against in-flight work, callback removal, ring teardown, guest allocations, and references must be preserved.

provenance: exact TU1 generated ReXGlue body: 19 PPC instructions
TU1 reference at 0x8328D70C to label Outline Renderer
candidates.observed_arguments_and_layout: G1 did not establish a renderer object layout or a render-operation ABI.
candidates.distinguishing_evidence: The label proves an engine renderer concept exists, but not that this short function submits rendering work; it may only register a subsystem/type.
candidates.expected_side_effects_and_risks: Hooking a registration constructor could corrupt startup/type tables while yielding no frame commands.

provenance: exact TU1 generated ReXGlue body: 19 PPC instructions
TU1 reference at 0x8329014C to label LightingManager Renderer
candidates.observed_arguments_and_layout: G1 did not establish a renderer object layout or a render-operation ABI.
candidates.distinguishing_evidence: The label proves a Lionhead renderer identity, not a command/draw method. The function may only register or construct it.
candidates.expected_side_effects_and_risks: Premature hooking risks registration/type initialization with no semantic capture value.
